en.text: Which of the following are possible causes of income inequality among individuals?

zh.text: 下列哪些是導致不同人之間收入不均的可能原因？
種族的差異
資本擁有權的差異
健康的差異
香港中學文憑考試 2012 卷一 第 21 題

en.text: Li Ka Shing Foundation gave HK$5 000 to each 2017 HKDSE candidate living in those remote districts with lower average household income. Which of the following statement about this unconditional gift is correct?

zh.text: 李嘉誠基金會向每位居住在那些平均住戶收入較低之偏遠地區的2017年香港中學文憑考試考生派發港幣5 000元。下列哪項有關該無條件饋贈的陳述是正確的？

en.text: It reduces the income inequality as a larger portion of the receivers of the gift are from lower income group.

zh.text: 這減低了收入不均，因為收到該饋贈的人較大部分來自低收入組別。

en.text: It increases the income inequality as it is unfair to the candidates living in the non-remote districts.

zh.text: 這增加了收入不均，因為對居住在非偏遠地區的考生並不公平。

en.text: As the money is given to all candidates living in those remote districts, income distribution remains unchanged.

zh.text: 因為該款項是給予那些居住在偏遠地區的所有考生，所以收入分配維持不變。

en.text: It helps equalizing opportunities as those candidates will study harder to improve their exam results.

zh.text: 這有助機會均等化，因為那些考生會更用功讀書以提高其考試成績。
香港中學文憑考試 2017 卷一 第 20 題

en.text: The following diagram shows the Gini coefficient of Hong Kong based on original household income.

en.text: the income level of Hong Kong people increased.

zh.text: 香港人的收入水平上升。

en.text: income for high income household increased while income for low income household decreased.

zh.text: 高收入住戶的收入增加而低收入住戶的收入減少。

en.text: the welfare policy failed to reduce the income inequality.

zh.text: 福利政策未能減低收入不均。
收入差距日漸擴大。
香港中學文憑考試 2017 卷一 第 21 題

en.text: The Work Incentive Transport Subsidy Scheme helps low-income earners reduce their cost of travelling to and from work and encourages them to get a job. Workers meeting certain criteria, such as monthly income and asset limited, are eligible to get the subsidy.

zh.text: 「鼓勵就業交通津貼計劃」協助低收入在職人士減低往返工作地點的交通費負擔，並鼓勵他們就業。工人只要符合指定條件，例如每月收入限額及資產限額，便有資格獲得津貼。

en.text: Which of the following would likely occur after the implementation of this scheme?

zh.text: 在上述計劃推行後，下列哪些會可能出現？
勞力供應會增加。
勞工生產力會增加。

en.text: Geographical mobility of labour would increase.

zh.text: 勞工的地域流動性會增加。
收入不均會下降。
香港中學文憑考試 2017 卷一 第 22 題

en.text: Women tend to leave the job market earlier than men for taking care of the family, leading to fewer women to take up senior positions in companies.

zh.text: 勞動市場的性別歧視存在於年長一輩中。

zh.text: 人力資本的積累導致不同年齡組別的收入差異。

en.text: Which of the following are possible explanations for the above difference in the Gini coefficient?

zh.text: 下列哪些是上述堅尼系數差異的可能解釋？

en.text: The salaries of workers in the accommodation and food services industry are lower than that of professionals in the finance and insurance industry.

zh.text: 住宿及膳食服務業工人的薪金較金融及保險業專才的低。

en.text: Compared to professionals in the finance and insurance industry, the levels of human capital tend to be more homogeneous among workers in the accommodation and food services industry.

zh.text: 與金融及保險業專才相比，住宿及膳食服務業工人之間的人力資本水平傾向較同質。

en.text: The wage payment method for professionals in the finance and insurance industry is mostly basic salary plus commission while that for workers in the accommodation and food services industry is mostly time rate.

zh.text: 金融及保險業專才的薪酬支付方式多為底薪加佣金，而住宿及膳食服務業工人的薪酬支付方式多為以時計薪。
